'''The First''' was the name given to an enormous [[yozusk]] that lived in the swamps and jungle south of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the First occupied a region of the [[Malignant Bog]] known as the [[Fen of the First]] until it was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The First appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the World Boss on Dromund Kaas. it is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was killed.
